title: Expected shortfall estimation and capital coverage under overlapping scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2610.41624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expected shortfall (ES) is routinely estimated from a short sample of profit-and-loss (P&L) scenarios built from overlapping multi-day returns, while the non-parametric estimators applied to such data are designed under independent sampling. We study how this mismatch affects estimation accuracy and capital coverage, and how it interacts with serial dependence and heavy tails in the underlying P&L. Working within the coherent risk estimation framework, we compare six order-statistic-based ES estimators on fit, bias, and capital-coverage metrics. Following the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB), we use a one-year estimation window and ES at the $2.5\%$ confidence level as a benchmark setup. We combine simulations with market data on twelve risk factors and ninety-nine equity portfolios. We show that overlapping sampling does not merely add noise but shifts ES estimates systematically downward, thereby weakening capital coverage

translated_title: 重叠情景下的预期损失估计与资本覆盖
translated_abstract: 预期损失通常是基于由重叠多日收益率构建的损益情景短样本进行估计的，而应用于此类数据的非参数估计器却是在独立抽样假设下设计的。我们研究了这种不匹配如何影响估计精度和资本覆盖，以及它如何与底层损益序列中的序列依赖性和厚尾特征相互作用。在一致性风险估计框架内，我们基于拟合度、偏差和资本覆盖指标比较了六种基于次序统计量的预期损失估计器。遵循交易账簿基本审查的要求，我们以一年期估计窗口和2.5%置信水平的预期损失作为基准设置。我们将模拟与涵盖十二个风险因子和九十九个股票投资组合的市场数据相结合。研究表明，重叠抽样不仅仅是增加噪声，还会使预期损失估计系统性地下移，从而削弱资本覆盖。
tldr: 论文揭示了基于重叠多日收益构建的短样本估计预期损失时，因独立抽样假设失配会使估计值系统性偏低、削弱资本覆盖，并在一致性风险估计框架下系统比较了六种基于次序统计量的ES估计器的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that estimating expected shortfall from short samples of overlapping multi-day returns—under estimators designed for independent sampling—systematically biases ES estimates downward and weakens capital coverage, comparing six order-statistic-based ES estimators within the coherent risk estimation framework.
